name: Apar Industries Ltd.
business_summary: Indian electrification play with three segments: (1) conductors (aluminium alloy/ACSR/HTLS, large export share), (2) transformer and specialty oils (base-oil based; KSA unit under way), (3) power, telecom and specialty cables (incl. renewables, EV, defence). FY26 sales Rs22,902 cr (+23%), TTM Rs25,605 cr, EBITDA margin 9.5% TTM, Q2 FY27 PAT Rs447 cr (+78% YoY) with margin +190bp YoY. Metal-linked pricing makes revenue volatile while per-tonne conversion margins drive profit. Market cap Rs66,330 cr, P/E 47x, stock +90% in 12 months. Segment/geography splits are model knowledge, not verified in fetched sources.

exposures.mechanism: Conductors (AAAC/ACSR/HTLS) and transformer oils are the T&D build-out plays; Q2 FY27 earnings-call headline cites order strength. Structural: +1 SSU ~ +8% T&D-linked volume growth, EBITDA op. leverage ~1.5x, EV/MCap ~1.1, persistence 0.5 (priced at 47x PE already) => ~ +4.

evidence.note: Yahoo: 'Profit jumps 78% as order ...' earnings call highlights (headline only)

exposures.mechanism: Domestic conductor/cable orders from PGCIL, state utilities, railways follow central/state capex. +10% capex growth ~ +3% domestic volumes, EBITDA +4.5%, x1.1 x0.5 persistence ~ +2.5, shaded to 1.5 because T_GRID_ELECTRIFICATION already carries the structural part (layering).
Renewable-evacuation conductors, solar/EV/specialty cables and (via KSA unit) specialty oils. Judgemental; no company-disclosed numeric split in fetched sources.

Aluminium alloy rod is ~30% of costs (model knowledge) but conductor contracts are mostly LME-linked back-to-back, so margin per tonne is roughly neutral; +10% LME raises revenue/working capital and brings inventory gains (~1 month stock => ~+2% EBITDA one-off) but squeezes working-capital finance (interest Rs504 cr TTM). Net small positive; empirical +2.3/SSU t=1.5 agrees in sign, not significant.
Copper is the cable conductor (~10% of costs, model knowledge); pass-through pricing as for aluminium; inventory gain/loss dominates. Empirical +1.45 t=1.1.

Transformer/specialty oil base oils are crude derivatives (oils ~25-30% of revenue, base oil ~70% of oil cost; model knowledge). +10% Brent => base oil ~+6% with 1-2 month price lag; unrecovered ~0.5% of group revenue ~ Rs 125 cr/yr vs EBITDA Rs2,426 cr => ~-5% EBITDA, persistence 0.25, EV/MCap 1.1 => ~ -1.4.

Exports are a large share (~40%, model knowledge) of revenue; metal is USD/LME-linked so net exposure is the conversion margin (~Rs 1,200 cr). +3% USD/INR => ~+1.5% EBITDA before hedges, persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.1 => ~+0.8; partly hedged so shaded to +1.0 incl. translation of foreign-subsidiary earnings.

RBI hiked repo to 5.50% on 2026-10-07 (calibrated tightening). Interest cost Rs504 cr TTM, screener flags high cost of borrowing; +25bp on ~Rs 5,000-6,000 cr borrowings (assumed) = Rs 13-15 cr = ~0.6% of EBITDA; the larger channel is the discount rate on a 47x P/E stock (duration effect ~ -1.2).

evidence.note: Google News: Reuters 2026-10-07 'India first hike in nearly 4 years'; SCC Online 'repo to 5.50%, calibrated tightening'

exposures.mechanism: Market beta 1.4-1.5, 1y vol 46%, +90% in 12 months, FIIs raised stake to 12.55%; a +5 VIX shock hits high-multiple mid-cap capital goods harder than market. Empirical -0.53 (t=-0.7).

US/Americas conductors, transformer oil and cable exports (US share not verified in fetched sources). +10pp tariff on ~10% of revenue at 30% pricing pass-through => ~-3% revenue-equiv, margin 9.5% => ~-10% EBITDA if borne 30%, persistence 0.25-0.5 => ~-2.5.

KSA specialty-oil unit (Yanbu lubeHub supply pact, 2026-10-14) and Gulf/Africa conductor exports; escalation delays projects and shipping, but higher energy prices lift Gulf capex over time. Ambiguous sign; low confidence.

evidence.note: scanx.trade: KSA unit signs supply pact at Yanbu lubeHub

exposures.mechanism: Empirical +3.36/SSU, t=+2.5 (beta 1.21); plausible channel is US data-centre/grid capex sentiment feeding conductor/specialty-cable demand plus global-risk appetite. Shrunk toward zero to 1.2 because mechanism is indirect.
